# Inonda LTD

> Inonda LTD is a residential property management company based in Nicosia, Cyprus. It manages rental properties for landlords, investors and homeowners across Cyprus, with maintenance and repairs, property inspections, tenant communication and regular owner reporting. The website is available in Greek, English, Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew and Romanian.

Key facts:

- Company: Inonda LTD, Nicosia, Cyprus
- Service: residential and rental property management (Διαχείριση ακινήτων)
- Areas served: Nicosia, Strovolos, Latsia, Aglantzia, Lakatamia, Engomi, Limassol, Larnaca, Protaras, Agia Napa and island-wide in Cyprus
- Phone: +357 94 091 613 (office / maintenance), +357 94 091 616 (director)
- WhatsApp / Viber: +357 94 091 613
- Email: inonda2026@outlook.com
- Free, no-obligation property assessment for owners
- Fees depend on property type and the services required; quotes are tailored after the assessment

## Services (English)

- [Property management services](https://inonda.site/en/property-management-services/): overview of how Inonda LTD manages a rental property in Cyprus
- [Maintenance and repairs](https://inonda.site/en/property-maintenance-repairs/): 24/7 issue reporting, vetted contractors, preventive maintenance, cost approval and a digital maintenance log
- [Property inspections](https://inonda.site/en/property-inspections/): move-in, routine and move-out inspections with dated photos and written reports
- [For property owners](https://inonda.site/en/property-owners/): the three-step management process and the free assessment request form
- [Service areas](https://inonda.site/en/service-areas/): towns and regions covered in Cyprus

## Guides for landlords (English)

- [Renting out property in Cyprus: a landlord's guide](https://inonda.site/en/guides/landlord-guide-cyprus/): From preparing the property to returning the deposit: every step of renting out a home in Cyprus.
- [Property management fees in Cyprus: what you pay for](https://inonda.site/en/guides/property-management-fees-cyprus/): Pricing models, what is included, hidden extras, and the questions to ask before you sign.
- [Move-in and move-out inspection checklist for Cyprus rentals](https://inonda.site/en/guides/property-inspection-checklist/): A room-by-room checklist to document condition and avoid deposit disputes.
- [Managing a Cyprus property from abroad](https://inonda.site/en/guides/manage-cyprus-property-from-abroad/): Bills, taxes, vacant-home care and local support for owners living outside Cyprus.
